ToneOptions.Label: Strategic & Visionary
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Adopt a forward-thinking, strategic tone emphasizing long-term IT operational excellence and competitive advantage.

ToneOptions.Label: Data-Driven & Analytical
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Utilize a precise, data-centric tone focusing on quantifiable improvements and ML-driven insights.

ToneOptions.Label: Risk-Conscious & Resilient
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Employ a measured, risk-aware tone highlighting system stability and business continuity assurance.

ToneOptions.Label: Efficiency & Optimization
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Convey a pragmatic, results-oriented tone focused on operational efficiency and resource optimization.

GoalOptions.Label: Minimize Downtime
GoalOptions.Text: To demonstrate how AIOSUP01 significantly reduces unplanned IT incidents and service disruptions. Success means achieving a measurable reduction in critical incident frequency and duration, thereby enhancing overall service availability and user satisfaction.

GoalOptions.Label: Enhance Efficiency
GoalOptions.Text: To showcase the system's ability to automate incident detection and facilitate faster root cause analysis. Success involves reducing manual intervention in IT operations and accelerating mean time to resolution (MTTR) for identified issues.

GoalOptions.Label: Optimize Resources
GoalOptions.Text: To illustrate how AIOSUP01 enables proactive resource management and capacity planning by predicting potential bottlenecks. Success is defined by improved resource utilization and avoidance of costly over-provisioning or emergency scaling.

GoalOptions.Label: Strengthen Security Posture
GoalOptions.Text: To highlight the system's role in identifying anomalous behavior that could indicate security threats or compliance deviations. Success means proactively mitigating risks and ensuring a more secure and compliant IT environment.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Commercial Impact
Criteria: Quantifiable reduction in operational costs due to fewer incidents.
Demonstrable improvement in end-user productivity and satisfaction.
Positive impact on key business metrics (e.g., revenue, customer retention).
Alignment with strategic business objectives for digital transformation.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Technical Performance
Criteria: Accuracy and precision of ML model predictions for incident likelihood.
Latency and throughput of data ingestion and analysis pipeline.
Scalability of the system to handle increasing data volumes and complexity.
Integration capabilities with existing IT management tools and workflows.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Operational Resilience
Criteria: Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF) for critical IT services.
Reduction in Mean Time To Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time To Resolve (MTTR) incidents.
Effectiveness of automated remediation actions triggered by the system.
Compliance with relevant IT governance frameworks (e.g., ITIL, COBIT).
